lib.title: Library
lib.subtitle: {n} games with a known process · updated {date}
lib.empty.title: Nothing found
lib.empty.text: Try another name or turn on “Show games without exe”.
fav.title: Favorites
fav.empty.title: Nothing here yet
fav.empty.text: Press the star on a game tile to add it here.
detail.finding: Looking for an installed copy of the game…
detail.notInstalled: No installed copy found, and that is fine: the decoy does not need one.
detail.noteDone: You can stop it now, the quest should be counted.
detail.noteRunning: The process runs in the background. You can minimize the window to the tray.
detail.noExe.title: Discord does not know this game's exe yet
detail.noExe.text: It cannot be detected by process. Press “Update database” later: once Discord adds an exe, the game becomes available.
running.title: Running
running.empty.title: Nothing is running
running.empty.text: Open a game in the library and press “Start decoy”.
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.desc: Interface language. New languages are added as files in the locales folder.
settings.defaultTime.desc: How many minutes to keep the process (Discord quests usually need 15).
settings.autoStop.desc: The decoy ends by itself when the time is up.
settings.notify.desc: A Windows notification when the time is up.
settings.tray.desc: Decoys keep running while the app is in the tray.
settings.showNoExe.desc: Entries where Discord does not know the process yet (they cannot be started).
settings.dataDir.desc: Where the game list and settings are stored.
settings.dataDir.portable: Portable mode: everything is stored next to decoy.exe.
settings.legal: Decoy does not use your Discord token and does not accept quests for you. Faking a game process may go against Discord's rules, use it at your own risk.
toast.launched: “{name}” started for {n} min. Discord should notice it in about 15 seconds.
toast.timeUp: Time is up, the quest should be counted
toast.refreshUpToDate: The database is already up to date
lab.title: Lab
lab.subtitle: A secret tab: starts many decoys at once.
lab.count.desc: Games are picked at random, ones already running are skipped. Each one runs for {n} min (set in Settings).
lab.warn: Every decoy is a separate process with a window. More than 200–300 at once may slow your computer down, the maximum is {max}.
notify.title: Time is up
